items.question: Which bodily locations are assigned to Sāvitrī and Savitā in the installation sequence?
premises: Sāvitrī and Savitā are named as the entities to be placed.
The term tadvadupabāhau indicates their placement likewise on the forearms.
The terms karau and hṛdi indicate the hands are located at the heart.
items.inference: Sāvitrī and Savitā are assigned to the forearms in like manner, with the hands placed at the heart.
uncertainties: The exact syntactic relation between karau and hṛdi is compressed and inferred from the installation context.
items.plain_english: Sāvitrī and Savitā are likewise placed on the forearms, and the hands are placed at the heart.
